To obtain the given clamped output waveform where the negative peaks are clamped/limited below a specific reference voltage $V_2$ and positive peaks are limited at $V_1$, we employ a combination of a biased diode clamper (or limiter) circuit.

### Circuit Configuration
```text
         D1 (Limit pos at V1)
      +---|>|---+---||---+
      |         |   C    |
  ----o---------o--------o---- Vi
      |         |
      +---|<|---+
         D2 (Limit neg at V2 with DC source)
```
To achieve both positive and negative clipping/clamping as shown in Figure Q.3 ($|V_{s}| > |V|$), a double-ended limiter circuit consisting of two diodes connected in parallel opposition with independent DC battery sources $V_1$ and $V_2$ is used.
proTip: Analyze positive and negative half-cycles independently by checking diode conduction states based on the applied bias voltages $V_1$ and $V_2$.
